title: From tees to trees: Harvington Wood takes shape
body: The Heart of England Forest has begun turning the former 47-hectare golf course at Manor Farm, Anchor Lane, Harvington, into woodland, wetland and wildflower meadow, with new footpaths to explore. Work started in August and is due to finish in April 2027, with 35,000 trees and 340 metres of new hedgerow planned. Low-lying areas will become wet woodland, and old bunkers and drains are being reshaped to hold water and slow flooding.
